name: BillHarbor (Dev)
short_desc: Development receipt acquisition and authenticated delivery control plane
author: EckPhi
description: Vendor-independent receipt and bill acquisition with immutable originals, OIDC sign-in and installable connector plugins. Development release; starts without vendors.

form_fields.label: Public HTTPS origin
form_fields.hint: Exact browser origin without trailing slash, e.g. https://bills.example.com. HTTPS exposure is required.

form_fields.label: OIDC issuer
form_fields.hint: Exact HTTPS issuer URL from your identity provider.

form_fields.label: OIDC client ID
form_fields.hint: Register a confidential authorization-code client with callback <public origin>/auth/callback.

form_fields.label: Administrator subject
form_fields.hint: OIDC sub claim for the initial administrator, not an email address unless your provider uses it as sub.

form_fields.label: OIDC client secret
form_fields.hint: Client secret from your identity provider. For values containing dollar signs use secrets/oidc-client-secret as documented.

form_fields.label: Credential encryption key
form_fields.hint: Generated once. Back up with secrets and state; do not change after initialization.
